data.name: Kirti
data.gender_notes: Kirti is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit kīrti, 'fame, glory', from the root kīrt, 'to praise'. Its root is Sanskrit kīrti (कीर्ति). A classical Sanskrit term for fame. Kirti is a Sanskrit name meaning “Fame; glory; renown”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kirti expresses “Fame; glory; renown”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit kīrti, 'fame, glory', from the root kīrt, 'to praise'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kirti total 31, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
